text: The eggs arrived with 4 out of 6 completely cracked and leaking inside the bag. Everything else got messy too.
Ordered at 9 PM and it showed up in just 7 minutes. Genuinely impressed with how fast this is.
My order has been stuck on 'Packing' for 25 minutes now. This is way past your 10-minute promise.
The delivery partner threw the bag at my door and left without ringing the bell. Very unprofessional.
I was charged twice for the same order. ₹450 was deducted from my card two times.
Paneer packet was spoiled and smelled sour. Had to throw the whole thing away.
Can you add an option to schedule deliveries for a specific time slot instead of instant only?
App crashes every single time I open the coupons page. Please fix this.
I ordered 2kg of onions but received only 500g. Charged for the full 2kg though.
Delivery boy was polite and even helped carry the heavy water cans to my third floor. Great service!
Received expired yogurt, the date on the packet says it expired two days ago. This is a health risk.
The app keeps logging me out randomly in the middle of checkout. Super frustrating.
My refund for the missing items from last week still hasn't been processed. It's been 6 days.
Absolutely love the new dark mode! Makes ordering at night so much easier on the eyes.
Order took 45 minutes to arrive and the ice cream I ordered had completely melted.
The delivery partner used extremely abusive language when I asked him to wait 2 minutes.
Payment failed on the app but money was deducted from my UPI account. Order was never placed.
Bread I received was moldy on one side. Completely inedible.
Please bring back the option to leave a tip for delivery partners, I miss that feature.
Wrong order delivered again! This is the third time this month I've received someone else's groceries.
Super quick delivery for my late night snack cravings. Ordered chips and soda, arrived in 6 minutes.
The app doesn't let me change my delivery address after placing the order, even within a minute.
I was overcharged ₹30 extra as a 'surge fee' that wasn't shown during checkout.
Chicken package was leaking blood all over my grocery bag, very unhygienic packaging.
Delivery partner called me 5 times before even leaving the store, kept asking silly questions.
The new UI redesign looks fantastic, much cleaner and easier to browse categories now.
My order got cancelled automatically without any notification and I was still charged.
Milk was delivered without any leak or damage, and the delivery guy was very courteous. Thank you!
I keep getting the wrong OTP for delivery verification, had to call support twice.
I want to uninstall this app, every order this week has had a missing or damaged item.
The tomatoes were rotten and squished at the bottom of the bag, ruined the other vegetables too.
Great job on reducing delivery times, my last 5 orders all came within 8 minutes.
Delivery partner refused to bring the order to my apartment and asked me to come to the gate myself.
I was double billed for a cancelled order. Please refund the amount immediately.
Ordered baby diapers urgently at midnight and they arrived in 9 minutes. Lifesaver.
The search bar doesn't show results for half the products I type in, very buggy.
Found a dead insect inside the sealed cereal box I ordered. This is extremely unacceptable.
My address got auto-changed to an old saved address and the order went to the wrong place.
Delivery partner was very friendly and even gave tips on which fruits were freshest. Loved it.
I've been charged a delivery fee even though I'm a premium member with free delivery.
Ice packs were missing from my frozen food order, everything arrived partially thawed.
Please add a feature to reorder my last purchase with a single tap, would save so much time.
Delivery partner threatened to cancel my order if I didn't come downstairs immediately.
Received a totally different brand of rice than what I ordered and paid for the premium one.
The packaging for fragile items like glass jars has improved a lot, nothing broke this time.
App shows 'order delivered' but I never received anything. Need this investigated urgently.
Vegetables were fresh and exactly as pictured on the app. Very satisfied with quality control.
The wallet refund from last week's complaint still hasn't reflected in my account balance.
Delivery partner was rude on call and hung up on me when I asked about order status.
Excellent experience overall, fast delivery, correct items, and a very polite delivery partner.
